The '''''Glasgow Mathematical Journal''''' is a [[mathematics journal]] that publishes original [[Academic publishing#Scholarly paper|research papers]] in any branch of [[pure mathematics|pure]] and [[applied mathematics|applied]] [[mathematics]]. It covers a wide variety of research areas, which in recent issues have included [[ring theory]], [[group theory]], [[functional analysis]], [[combinatorics]], [[differential equation]]s, [[differential geometry]], [[number theory]], [[algebraic topology]], and the application of such methods in applied mathematics.<ref>[https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/glasgow-mathematical-journal Cambridge Journals]</ref>

The [[editor-in-chief]] is currently A. Bartel ([[University of Glasgow]]).
